skills.title: RTK (safe wrapper)
skills.description: Use an already-installed RTK to compress verbose shell output; never auto-installs binaries or global hooks.
skills.upstreamNote: The upstream rtk-integration 1.1.0 scan was suspicious because it auto-runs an unpinned remote installer and edits shell profiles. This committed wrapper deliberately removes that behavior.
